    Free presentations and the Nakayama map #

    FreePres A Z: generators z : Fin n₀ → Z and relation rows F : Fin n₁ → Fin n₀ → A presenting Z, i.e. an exact sequence Aⁿ¹ → Aⁿ⁰ → Z → 0. Every finite-dimensional module has one (FreePres.exists). A tuple w ∈ Wⁿ⁰ killed by the relations comes from a unique A-linear map Z → W (FreePres.lift).

    theta identifies Hom_A(W, DAⁿ) with the k-dual of Wⁿ, and nu F : DAⁿ¹ → DAⁿ⁰ is the Nakayama transform of the presentation, with theta (nu F ∘ ψ) = theta ψ ∘ F (theta_nu_comp).

    A free presentation Aⁿ¹ → Aⁿ⁰ → Z → 0.

    • n₀ : ℕ

    • F : Fin self.n₁ → Fin self.n₀ → A
